lines.text: Hey! I'm busy. Don't bother me,
I'm thinking of a new beat. Wanna hear it?
Did you bring the schedule? Let me see.
You're not trying to get me wrapped up in a scandal, are you?
Can you even sing? Let's do a duet sometime.
Are you okay with me calling you Manager? How does "Honey" sound?
What are you doing? I need to hurry in order to make this show.
I enjoy just staying still and looking at your face, Manager. It gives me inspiration.
This shopping mall seems all right.
I'm going to hold a solo concert at the Theater soon.
Too bad there aren't any hip-hop clubs around.
Hi, are you my new manager? I look forward to working with you.
Now I can concentrate more on singing.
Wow, you're pretty quick. Thank you.
A fan gave me the same thing, but thank you.
I make fat stacks, so you don't have to get me anything.
Don't you think you're due for a "promotion"?
Y'know... our relationship is starting to become a little unprofessional. Not that I mind...
I'm thinking about making my next song about the comfort love brings.
Looks like I've got a new audience.
